```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

save_placeholder_svg <- function(file, title, detail = "No results available") {
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.15, label = title, fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = -0.10, label = detail, size = 4) +
    xlim(-1, 1) + ylim(-1, 1) + theme_void()
  ggsave(file, p, width = 7, height = 5, device = "svg")
  invisible(p)
}

save_placeholder_pdf <- function(file, title, detail = "No results available",
                                 width = 8, height = 6) {
  grDevices::pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
  plot.new()
  title(main = title, sub = detail)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}

write_empty_csv <- function(file, columns) {
  x <- as.data.frame(setNames(replicate(length(columns), logical(0), simplify = FALSE), columns))
  write.csv(x, file, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
if (!file.exists(params$stability_file)) {
  stop("Stability table not found: ", params$stability_file)
}

stability_raw <- read.csv(
  params$stability_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (!all(c("Contrast", "Gene") %in% names(stability_raw))) {
  stop("The stability table must contain Contrast and Gene columns.")
}

available_stability_contrasts <- unique(stability_raw$Contrast)

if (params$stability_flag_column %in% names(stability_raw)) {
  stability_raw$selected_stable <- as_flag(
    stability_raw[[params$stability_flag_column]]
  )
} else if (all(c("Method", "robust_effect") %in% names(stability_raw))) {
  stability_raw <- stability_raw[
    grepl("bootstrap", stability_raw$Method, ignore.case = TRUE),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]
  available_stability_contrasts <- unique(stability_raw$Contrast)
  stability_raw$selected_stable <- as_flag(stability_raw$robust_effect)
} else {
  stop(
    "Could not find '", params$stability_flag_column,
    "' or long-format Method/robust_effect columns."
  )
}

stable_gene_table <- stability_raw %>%
  filter(selected_stable) %>%
  distinct(Contrast, Gene)

write.csv(
  stable_gene_table,
  file.path(params$output_root, "bootstrap_stable_genes_all_contrasts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

contrast_names <- c(
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H",
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L",
  "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
)

stable_counts <- list()

for (contrast_name in contrast_names) {
  source_file <- file.path(
    params$original_crc_de_dir,
    paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
  )
  if (!file.exists(source_file)) stop("Missing CRC DEG file: ", source_file)

  tab <- read.csv(source_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  stable_genes <- stable_gene_table$Gene[
    stable_gene_table$Contrast == contrast_name
  ]

  if (contrast_name %in% available_stability_contrasts) {
    tab$bootstrap_stable <- rownames(tab) %in% stable_genes
  } else {
    
    
    tab$bootstrap_stable <- TRUE
  }

  write.csv(tab, file.path(stable_crc_de_dir, paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")))
  write.csv(
    tab[tab$bootstrap_stable, , drop = FALSE],
    file.path(stable_crc_only_dir, paste0(contrast_name, ".csv"))
  )

  stable_counts[[contrast_name]] <- data.frame(
    Contrast = contrast_name,
    Genes_tested = nrow(tab),
    Bootstrap_stable = sum(tab$bootstrap_stable),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stable_counts <- bind_rows(stable_counts)
write.csv(
  stable_counts,
  file.path(params$output_root, "bootstrap_stable_gene_counts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(stable_counts)
```

```{r}
fit_three_group_edger <- function(counts, clinical_data, min_count = 10) {
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(clinical_data))
  counts <- counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  clinical_data <- clinical_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts), rownames(clinical_data)))

  y <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB, min.count = min_count)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")

  design <- model.matrix(~0 + clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
  colnames(design) <- levels(clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)

  contrasts <- list(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H, levels = design),
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design),
    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design)
  )

  lapply(contrasts, function(ct) {
    qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = ct)
    tab <- qlf$table
    tab$FDR <- p.adjust(tab$PValue, method = "BH")
    tab
  })
}

ucec_available <- all(file.exists(file.path(
  params$original_ucec_de_dir,
  paste0(contrast_names, ".csv")
)))

if (ucec_available) {
  for (contrast_name in contrast_names) {
    tab <- read.csv(
      file.path(params$original_ucec_de_dir, paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")),
      row.names = 1,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    tab$bootstrap_stable <- TRUE
    write.csv(tab, file.path(stable_ucec_de_dir, paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")))
  }
} else {
  ucec_clinical <- read.csv(
    params$ucec_clinical_file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
    na.strings = c("NA", "")
  )
  rownames(ucec_clinical) <- ucec_clinical$sample_submitter_id
  ucec_clinical <- ucec_clinical[!is.na(ucec_clinical$MSI_TMB), , drop = FALSE]
  ucec_clinical$MSI_TMB <- factor(
    ucec_clinical$MSI_TMB,
    levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L"),
    labels = c("MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L")
  )

  ucec_counts <- as.matrix(read.csv(
    params$ucec_counts_file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  ))
  storage.mode(ucec_counts) <- "numeric"

  ucec_results <- fit_three_group_edger(ucec_counts, ucec_clinical)
  for (contrast_name in names(ucec_results)) {
    tab <- ucec_results[[contrast_name]]
    tab$bootstrap_stable <- TRUE
    write.csv(tab, file.path(stable_ucec_de_dir, paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")))
  }
}
```

```{r}
    expr_hallmark,
```

```{r}
gsva_design <- model.matrix(~0 + crc_clinical$MSI_TMB)
colnames(gsva_design) <- levels(crc_clinical$MSI_TMB)
gsva_fit <- lmFit(gsva_scores, gsva_design)

gsva_contrasts <- makeContrasts(
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L,
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H,
  MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L,
  levels = gsva_design
)

gsva_fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(gsva_fit, gsva_contrasts))

gsva_results <- lapply(colnames(gsva_contrasts), function(contrast_name) {
  topTable(gsva_fit2, coef = contrast_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH") %>%
    rownames_to_column("pathway")
})
names(gsva_results) <- colnames(gsva_contrasts)

for (contrast_name in names(gsva_results)) {
  write.csv(
    gsva_results[[contrast_name]],
    file.path(gsea_out_dir, paste0(contrast_name, "_pathways.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

write_directional_pathways <- function(df, group_a, group_b) {
  up_a <- df %>% filter(logFC > params$pathway_logfc_cutoff, adj.P.Val < params$fdr_cutoff)
  down_a <- df %>% filter(logFC < -params$pathway_logfc_cutoff, adj.P.Val < params$fdr_cutoff)

  paths <- c(
    file.path(gsea_out_dir, group_a, "upregulated"),
    file.path(gsea_out_dir, group_a, "downregulated"),
    file.path(gsea_out_dir, group_b, "upregulated"),
    file.path(gsea_out_dir, group_b, "downregulated")
  )
  invisible(lapply(paths, dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))

  write.csv(up_a, file.path(paths[1], paste0("pathways_compared_to_", group_b, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(down_a, file.path(paths[2], paste0("pathways_compared_to_", group_b, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  up_b <- down_a %>% mutate(logFC = -logFC) %>% arrange(desc(logFC))
  down_b <- up_a %>% mutate(logFC = -logFC) %>% arrange(logFC)
  write.csv(up_b, file.path(paths[3], paste0("pathways_compared_to_", group_a, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(down_b, file.path(paths[4], paste0("pathways_compared_to_", group_a, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

for (contrast_name in names(gsva_results)) {
  groups <- strsplit(contrast_name, "_vs_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  write_directional_pathways(gsva_results[[contrast_name]], groups[1], groups[2])
}
```

```{r}
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, fatten = 0) +
    facet_wrap(~pathway, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(MSI_H = "#1f77b4", MSS_TMB_H = "#d62728", MSS_TMB_L = "#2ca02c")) +
    labs(title = "Per-sample GSVA scores by MSI/TMB group", x = NULL, y = "ssGSEA score") +

  mat <- gsva_scores[selected_pathways, rownames(crc_clinical), drop = FALSE]

  rownames(annotation) <- colnames(mat_z)
  ord <- order(annotation$MSI_TMB, colMeans(mat_z, na.rm = TRUE))

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat_z[, ord, drop = FALSE],
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    border_color = NA,
    annotation_col = annotation[ord, , drop = FALSE],
    annotation_colors = list(MSI_TMB = c(MSI_H = "#1f77b4", MSS_TMB_H = "#d62728", MSS_TMB_L = "#2ca02c")),
    filename = file.path(gsea_out_dir, "gsva_heatmap_selected_pathways_sorted.pdf"),
    width = 10,
    height = 2
  )
}
```

```{r}
read_deg <- function(file, contrast_name, flip_logfc = FALSE) {
  df <- read.csv(file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>% as_tibble()
  if (!"bootstrap_stable" %in% names(df)) df$bootstrap_stable <- TRUE
  df$bootstrap_stable <- as_flag(df$bootstrap_stable)
  if (flip_logfc) df$logFC <- -df$logFC

  df %>% mutate(
    contrast = contrast_name,
    sig = FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff & bootstrap_stable,
    direction = case_when(
      sig & logFC > 0 ~ "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
      sig & logFC < 0 ~ "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300))
  )
}

plot_volcano <- function(df, title, file, label_n = 12) {
  labels <- df %>% filter(sig) %>% arrange(FDR, desc(abs(logFC))) %>% slice_head(n = label_n)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(logFC, neglog10FDR)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-params$logfc_cutoff, params$logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(params$fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels, aes(label = Gene), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00",
      "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#0072B2",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )) +
    labs(title = title, x = "log2 fold-change", y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")), color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "top")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, device = "svg")
  p
}

save_venn <- function(sets, title, file, high_color) {
  if (all(vapply(sets, length, integer(1)) == 0)) {
    save_placeholder_svg(file, title, "No significant stable genes")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  p <- ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = high_color) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  ggsave(file, p, width = 7, height = 6, device = "svg")
  p
}
```

```{r}
make_shared_table <- function(crc_df, ucec_df) {
  inner_join(
    crc_df %>% filter(sig) %>% select(Gene, CRC = logFC),
    ucec_df %>% filter(sig) %>% select(Gene, UCEC = logFC),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>% mutate(consistent = sign(CRC) == sign(UCEC))
}
```

```{r}
safe_gost <- function(genes, sources = c("GO:BP", "REAC", "CORUM")) {
  genes <- unique(na.omit(genes))
  if (!params$run_gprofiler || length(genes) < 3 || !requireNamespace("gprofiler2", quietly = TRUE)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(
    gprofiler2::gost(
      query = genes,
      organism = "hsapiens",
      sources = sources,
      significant = TRUE,
      correction_method = "g_SCS"
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("g:Profiler failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
}

extract_gost <- function(gost_result, comparison, direction = "All", top_n = 10) {
  if (is.null(gost_result) || is.null(gost_result$result) || nrow(gost_result$result) == 0) return(tibble())
  gost_result$result %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
    group_by(source) %>% arrange(p_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = comparison,
      direction = direction,
      neglog10_p = -log10(p_value),
      term_label = paste0(source, ": ", str_trunc(term_name, 65))
    )
}

plot_enrichment <- function(df, title, file, direction_axis = FALSE) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    save_placeholder_svg(file, title, "No significant enrichment or too few genes")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (direction_axis) {
    df <- df %>% arrange(direction, p_value) %>%
      mutate(term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(unique(term_label))))
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(direction, term_label)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = intersection_size, color = neglog10_p), alpha = 0.9)
  } else {
    df <- df %>% arrange(p_value) %>%
      mutate(term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(unique(term_label))))
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(neglog10_p, term_label)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = intersection_size, color = source), alpha = 0.9)
  }
  p <- p + labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, size = "Gene count") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  ggsave(file, p, width = 8.5, height = 7, device = "svg")
  p
}

run_shared_enrichment <- function(shared_df, comparison_label, file_tag) {
  consistent <- shared_df %>% filter(consistent)
  up <- consistent %>% filter(CRC > 0, UCEC > 0) %>% pull(Gene)
  down <- consistent %>% filter(CRC < 0, UCEC < 0) %>% pull(Gene)

  directional <- bind_rows(
    extract_gost(safe_gost(up), comparison_label, "Up in MSS/TMB-H", 6),
    extract_gost(safe_gost(down), comparison_label, "Down in MSS/TMB-H", 6)
  )
  write.csv(directional, file.path(deg_plot_dir, paste0("directional_enrichment_", file_tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  plot_enrichment(
    directional,
    comparison_label,
    file.path(deg_plot_dir, paste0("directional_enrichment_", file_tag, ".svg")),
    direction_axis = TRUE
  )

  overall_result <- safe_gost(consistent$Gene)
  overall <- extract_gost(overall_result, comparison_label, "All", 10)
  write.csv(overall, file.path(deg_plot_dir, paste0("enrichment_", file_tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  plot_enrichment(
    overall,
    paste0("Shared DEGs: ", comparison_label, " (CRC + UCEC)"),
    file.path(deg_plot_dir, paste0("enrichment_dotplot_", file_tag, ".svg"))
  )

  go_only <- overall %>% filter(source == "GO:BP") %>% slice_head(n = 20)
  plot_enrichment(
    go_only,
    paste0("Shared DEGs: ", comparison_label, " (CRC + UCEC)"),
    file.path(deg_plot_dir, paste0("GO_dotplot_", file_tag, ".svg"))
  )
}

run_shared_enrichment(shared_msih, "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H", "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSI_H")
run_shared_enrichment(shared_mssl, "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L", "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L")
```

```{r}
prepare_clinical <- function(file) {
  x <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na.strings = c("NA", ""))
  rownames(x) <- x$sample_submitter_id
  x <- x[!is.na(x$MSI_TMB), , drop = FALSE]
  x$MSI_TMB <- factor(
    x$MSI_TMB,
    levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L"),
    labels = c("MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L")
  )
  x
}

fit_mirna_de <- function(count_file, clinical_file, output_dir) {
  clinical <- prepare_clinical(clinical_file)
  counts <- as.matrix(read.csv(count_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
  storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"
  colnames(counts) <- substr(colnames(counts), 1, 16)

  common <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(clinical))
  counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
  clinical <- clinical[common, , drop = FALSE]

  y <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = clinical$MSI_TMB)
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = clinical$MSI_TMB, min.count = 5)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")

  design <- model.matrix(~0 + clinical$MSI_TMB)
  colnames(design) <- levels(clinical$MSI_TMB)
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)

  contrasts <- list(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H, levels = design),
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design),
    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design)
  )

  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  results <- lapply(contrasts, function(ct) {
    qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = ct)
    tab <- qlf$table
    tab$FDR <- p.adjust(tab$PValue, "BH")
    tab
  })
  for (nm in names(results)) write.csv(results[[nm]], file.path(output_dir, paste0(nm, ".csv")))
  invisible(results)
}
```

```{r}
read_mir_de <- function(file, contrast_name, dataset, flip_logfc = FALSE) {
  df <- read.csv(file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("pre_miRNA") %>% as_tibble()
  if (flip_logfc) df$logFC <- -df$logFC
  df %>% mutate(
    contrast = contrast_name,
    dataset = dataset,
    sig = FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,
    direction = case_when(
      sig & logFC > 0 ~ "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
      sig & logFC < 0 ~ "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300))
  )
}

plot_mir_volcano <- function(df, title, file, label_n = 10) {
  labels <- df %>% filter(sig) %>% arrange(FDR, desc(abs(logFC))) %>% slice_head(n = label_n)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(logFC, neglog10FDR)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-params$logfc_cutoff, params$logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(params$fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels, aes(label = pre_miRNA), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00", "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#0072B2", "Not significant" = "grey75")) +
    labs(title = title, x = "log2 fold-change", y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")), color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "top")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, device = "svg")
}
```

```{r}
storage.mode(mir_counts) <- "numeric"

crc_clin_plot <- read.csv(params$clinical_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% mutate(dataset = "CRC")
ucec_clin_plot <- read.csv(params$ucec_clinical_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% mutate(dataset = "UCEC")
clinical_plot <- bind_rows(crc_clin_plot, ucec_clin_plot) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MSI_TMB)) %>%
  transmute(sample = sample_submitter_id, dataset, MSI_TMB = factor(MSI_TMB, levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L")))

common_mir_samples <- intersect(colnames(mir_counts), clinical_plot$sample)

  mir_long <- as.data.frame(t(mir_logcpm[shared_present, , drop = FALSE])) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    left_join(clinical_plot, by = "sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(shared_present), names_to = "pre_miRNA", values_to = "logCPM")

  p_box <- ggplot(mir_long, aes(MSI_TMB, logCPM, fill = MSI_TMB)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(dataset ~ pre_miRNA, scales = "free_y") +

    labs(title = "Expression of shared pre-miRNAs in CRC and UCEC", x = NULL, y = "TMM-normalized logCPM") +
    theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(file.path(mirna_plot_dir, "shared_pre_miRNA_expression_boxplots_COAD_UCEC.svg"), p_box, width = 14, height = 6, device = "svg")

  mir_summary <- mir_long %>% group_by(dataset, MSI_TMB, pre_miRNA) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(logCPM), se = sd(logCPM) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
  p_bar <- ggplot(mir_summary, aes(MSI_TMB, mean, fill = MSI_TMB)) +
    geom_col() + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(dataset ~ pre_miRNA, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("MSI-H" = "#009E73", "MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00", "MSS/TMB-L" = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(title = "Mean expression of shared pre-miRNAs", x = NULL, y = "Mean TMM-normalized logCPM") +
    theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(file.path(mirna_plot_dir, "shared_pre_miRNA_expression_barplots_COAD_UCEC.svg"), p_bar, width = 14, height = 6, device = "svg")
}
```

```{r}
      res <- multiMiR::get_multimir(mirna = mir, table = "validated", summary = TRUE)
      if (is.null(res@data) || nrow(res@data) == 0) return(tibble())
```

```{r}
  extract_gost(safe_gost(mir_supported_up), "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L", "Up in MSS/TMB-H", 6),
  extract_gost(safe_gost(mir_supported_down), "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L", "Down in MSS/TMB-H", 6)
)
write.csv(mir_enrichment, file.path(mirna_plot_dir, "GO_miRNA_supported_DE_genes_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
plot_enrichment(
  mir_enrichment,
  "Functional enrichment of miRNA-supported stable shared DE genes",
  file.path(mirna_plot_dir, "GO_dotplot_miRNA_supported_DE_genes_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.svg"),
  direction_axis = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
plot_string_network <- function(string_db, mapped_df, title, score_min = 400) {
  if (nrow(mapped_df) < 2) {
    plot.new(); title(main = title, sub = "Not enough mapped proteins")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  edges <- tryCatch(string_db$get_interactions(mapped_df$STRING_id), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(edges) || nrow(edges) == 0) {
    plot.new(); title(main = title, sub = "No STRING interactions")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  edges <- edges[edges$combined_score >= score_min, , drop = FALSE]
  vertices <- mapped_df %>% distinct(STRING_id, gene, logFC) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = if_else(logFC >= 0, "Up in MSS/TMB-H", "Down in MSS/TMB-H"),
      logFC_bin = cut(abs(logFC), breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, Inf), labels = c("< 0.5", "0.5-1", "1-2", "2-3", ">= 3"))
    )
  keep_ids <- intersect(vertices$STRING_id, unique(c(edges$from, edges$to)))
  vertices <- vertices %>% filter(STRING_id %in% keep_ids)
  edges <- edges %>% filter(from %in% keep_ids, to %in% keep_ids)
  if (nrow(vertices) < 2 || nrow(edges) == 0) {
    plot.new(); title(main = title, sub = "Network collapsed after filtering")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    edges %>% select(from, to),
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = vertices %>% transmute(name = STRING_id, gene, direction, logFC_bin)
  )
  p <- ggraph::ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +
    ggraph::geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.25, colour = "grey70") +
    ggraph::geom_node_point(aes(size = logFC_bin, fill = direction), shape = 21, colour = "black") +
    ggraph::geom_node_text(aes(label = gene), repel = TRUE, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#ff8f8f", "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#74aeff")) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("< 0.5" = 3.5, "0.5-1" = 6, "1-2" = 9, "2-3" = 12, ">= 3" = 15)) +
    labs(title = title, fill = "Direction", size = "|logFC|") +
    theme_void() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
contrast <- "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
selected_pathways <- c(
  "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_DN",
  "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING",
  "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",
  "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS"
)

string_all_pdf <- file.path(string_out_dir, paste0("all_", contrast, ".pdf"))
string_by_path_pdf <- file.path(string_out_dir, paste0("by_pathway_", contrast, ".pdf"))

if (!params$run_stringdb || !all(vapply(c("STRINGdb", "igraph", "ggraph"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE))) {
  save_placeholder_pdf(string_all_pdf, "STRING network", "STRING analysis disabled or packages missing")
  save_placeholder_pdf(string_by_path_pdf, "STRING networks by pathway", "STRING analysis disabled or packages missing")
} else {
  dge <- read.csv(file.path(stable_crc_de_dir, paste0(contrast, ".csv")), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(bootstrap_stable, FDR < params$fdr_cutoff)

  hallmark <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
    filter(gs_name %in% selected_pathways) %>%
    select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
  selected <- inner_join(dge, hallmark, by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol"))

  string_db <- tryCatch(
    STRINGdb::STRINGdb$new(version = "11.5", species = 9606, score_threshold = 400),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(string_db) || nrow(selected) == 0) {
    save_placeholder_pdf(string_all_pdf, "STRING network", "No stable selected genes or STRING initialization failed")
    save_placeholder_pdf(string_by_path_pdf, "STRING networks by pathway", "No stable selected genes or STRING initialization failed")
  } else {
    mapped <- tryCatch(
      string_db$map(selected, "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE),
      error = function(e) data.frame()
    )

    grDevices::pdf(string_all_pdf, width = 16, height = 12)
    plot_string_network(string_db, mapped, sprintf("STRING network: %s (n=%d proteins)", contrast, nrow(mapped)))
    grDevices::dev.off()

    grDevices::pdf(string_by_path_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)
    for (pw in selected_pathways) {
      sub <- mapped[mapped$gs_name == pw, , drop = FALSE]
      plot_string_network(string_db, sub, sprintf("%s (n=%d proteins)", pw, nrow(sub)))
    }
    grDevices::dev.off()
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)

output_dir <- "data/DE_results"


list.files(output_dir, full.names = FALSE)


de_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "DE_results.csv"
)

bootstrap_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "bootstrap_gene_summary.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(de_file)) {
  stop(
    "DE file does not exist: ", de_file,
    "\nAvailable files:\n",
    paste(list.files(output_dir), collapse = "\n")
  )
}

if (!file.exists(bootstrap_file)) {
  stop(
    "Bootstrap file does not exist: ", bootstrap_file,
    "\nAvailable files:\n",
    paste(list.files(output_dir), collapse = "\n")
  )
}

de_results <- read.csv(
  de_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

bootstrap_summary <- read.csv(
  bootstrap_file,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("DE results:", nrow(de_results), "genes\n")
cat("Bootstrap summary:", nrow(bootstrap_summary), "genes\n")

head(de_results)
head(bootstrap_summary)

read_result_file <- function(file, sheet = 1) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop("File does not exist: ", file)
  }

  extension <- tolower(tools::file_ext(file))

  result <- switch(
    extension,

    csv = read.csv(
      file,
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),

    tsv = read.delim(
      file,
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),

    txt = read.delim(
      file,
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),

    xlsx = openxlsx::read.xlsx(
      file,
      sheet = sheet,
      check.names = FALSE
    ),

    xls = openxlsx::read.xlsx(
      file,
      sheet = sheet,
      check.names = FALSE
    ),

    rds = readRDS(file),

    stop("Unsupported file type: ", extension)
  )

  as.data.frame(result)
}

output_dir <- "data/DE_results"

de_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "DE_results.csv"
)

bootstrap_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "bootstrap_gene_summary.csv"
)

de_results <- read_result_file(de_file)
bootstrap_summary <- read_result_file(bootstrap_file)





de_input <- de_results
bootstrap_input <- bootstrap_summary


fdr_threshold <- 0.05
repeated_significance_threshold <- 0.70
sign_consistency_threshold <- 0.90

output_file <- file.path(
  "data/DE_results",
  "DE_vs_bootstrap_comparison.xlsx"
)





find_column <- function(data, candidates, description) {
  found <- candidates[candidates %in% names(data)]

  if (length(found) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not find ", description, ". Available columns:\n",
      paste(names(data), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  found[1]
}

add_gene_column <- function(data) {
  gene_candidates <- c(
    "gene", "Gene", "genes", "symbol",
    "gene_symbol", "GeneSymbol"
  )

  found <- gene_candidates[gene_candidates %in% names(data)]

  if (length(found) > 0) {
    data <- data %>%
      rename(gene = all_of(found[1]))
  } else {
    current_rownames <- rownames(data)
    default_rownames <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(data)))

    if (
      !is.null(current_rownames) &&
      !identical(current_rownames, default_rownames)
    ) {
      data <- tibble::rownames_to_column(data, "gene")
    } else {
      stop("No gene column or gene row names were found.")
    }
  }

  data %>%
    mutate(gene = as.character(gene))
}

as_fraction <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)

  if (
    any(!is.na(x)) &&
    max(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1 &&
    max(x, na.rm = TRUE) <= 100
  ) {
    x <- x / 100
  }

  x
}





de <- add_gene_column(as.data.frame(de_input))

de_fdr_column <- find_column(
  de,
  c("FDR", "fdr", "padj", "adj.P.Val", "adjusted_pvalue"),
  "ordinary DE FDR column"
)

de_logfc_column <- find_column(
  de,
  c("logFC", "log2FoldChange", "log2FC", "estimate"),
  "ordinary DE logFC column"
)

de <- de %>%
  mutate(
    original_FDR = as.numeric(.data[[de_fdr_column]]),
    original_logFC = as.numeric(.data[[de_logfc_column]])
  )


original_de <- de %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(original_FDR),
    original_FDR <= fdr_threshold
  )





bootstrap <- add_gene_column(as.data.frame(bootstrap_input))

bootstrap_significance_column <- find_column(
  bootstrap,
  c(
    "repeated_significance",
    "significant_fraction",
    "significance_fraction",
    "significance_rate",
    "prop_significant",
    "proportion_significant",
    "fdr_pass_rate"
  ),
  "bootstrap repeated-significance column"
)

bootstrap_sign_column <- find_column(
  bootstrap,
  c(
    "sign_consistency",
    "sign_consistency_rate",
    "direction_consistency",
    "direction_stability",
    "prop_same_sign",
    "proportion_same_sign"
  ),
  "bootstrap sign-consistency column"
)

bootstrap <- bootstrap %>%
  mutate(
    bootstrap_significant_fraction =
      as_fraction(.data[[bootstrap_significance_column]]),

    bootstrap_sign_consistency =
      as_fraction(.data[[bootstrap_sign_column]])
  )


possible_group_columns <- c(
  "cancer", "project", "analysis",
  "comparison", "contrast"
)

group_columns <- possible_group_columns[
  possible_group_columns %in% names(original_de) &
    possible_group_columns %in% names(bootstrap)
]

join_columns <- c(group_columns, "gene")


duplicate_bootstrap <- bootstrap %>%
  count(across(all_of(join_columns)), name = "n") %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_bootstrap) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Bootstrap summary contains multiple rows for the same gene/comparison. ",
    "It must contain one gene-level summary row per comparison."
  )
}

bootstrap_for_join <- bootstrap %>%
  select(
    all_of(join_columns),
    bootstrap_significant_fraction,
    bootstrap_sign_consistency
  )





comparison_table <- original_de %>%
  left_join(
    bootstrap_for_join,
    by = join_columns
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bootstrap_pass = case_when(
      is.na(bootstrap_significant_fraction) |
        is.na(bootstrap_sign_consistency) ~ FALSE,

      bootstrap_significant_fraction >=
        repeated_significance_threshold &
        bootstrap_sign_consistency >=
        sign_consistency_threshold ~ TRUE,

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),

    bootstrap_failure_reason = case_when(
      bootstrap_pass ~ "Passed bootstrap",

      is.na(bootstrap_significant_fraction) |
        is.na(bootstrap_sign_consistency) ~
        "Missing from bootstrap summary",

      bootstrap_significant_fraction <
        repeated_significance_threshold &
        bootstrap_sign_consistency <
        sign_consistency_threshold ~
        "Low repeated significance and unstable direction",

      bootstrap_significant_fraction <
        repeated_significance_threshold ~
        "Low repeated significance",

      bootstrap_sign_consistency <
        sign_consistency_threshold ~
        "Unstable effect direction",

      TRUE ~ "Did not pass"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    across(any_of(group_columns)),
    bootstrap_pass,
    original_FDR
  )





count_summary <- comparison_table %>%
  group_by(across(any_of(group_columns))) %>%
  summarise(
    ordinary_DE_genes = n(),

    bootstrap_pass_genes =
      sum(bootstrap_pass, na.rm = TRUE),

    bootstrap_fail_genes =
      sum(!bootstrap_pass, na.rm = TRUE),

    percent_retained = round(
      100 * bootstrap_pass_genes / ordinary_DE_genes,
      2
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


genes_not_passing <- comparison_table %>%
  filter(!bootstrap_pass) %>%
  select(
    any_of(group_columns),
    gene,
    original_logFC,
    original_FDR,
    bootstrap_significant_fraction,
    bootstrap_sign_consistency,
    bootstrap_failure_reason,
    everything()
  )


genes_passing <- comparison_table %>%
  filter(bootstrap_pass)


print(count_summary)
print(genes_not_passing)





dir.create(
  dirname(output_file),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  list(
    Count_summary = count_summary,
    Genes_not_passing = genes_not_passing,
    Genes_passing = genes_passing,
    All_original_DE_genes = comparison_table
  ),
  file = output_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

message("Saved comparison to: ", output_file)
```
